The '''1971–72 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by ten points over nearest rival [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. [[Clyde F.C.|Clyde]] and [[Dunfermline Athletic F.C.|Dunfermline]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1972–73 Scottish Division Two|1972–73 Second Division]].
